caption: The drawing contains five distinct brass or gold-colored hardware pieces, each rendered with shading to suggest a metallic finish. At the top left, there is a vertically oriented escutcheon plate with a central keyhole and elaborate scrollwork edging at the top and bottom. On the upper right, there is a wider, horizontally oriented escutcheon plate, also containing a keyhole in the center with symmetrical, scroll-like extensions on both sides. At the center of the composition, there is a smaller escutcheon plate with a protruding, oval-shaped pull handle placed at an angle. Below, there is a large, ornate drawer pull with two rounded mounting bases on either side and an upward curving handle, attached to a backplate that features symmetrical, decorative contours. To the right of this handle, there is a side view depicting the profile of the same drawer pull, showing the handle extending away from the surface. The entire drawing is done in shades of yellow, gold, and brown, with shadowing and highlights indicating the reflective surface of the metal. The drawing includes a small measurement scale in inches in the lower left corner, and the artist’s name, "JANET RIZA," is written in the bottom right corner. The background is a plain, light beige color, and all elements are outlined in a darker shade for clarity.
title: Drawer Pull
